source.roof_plan_rule: plane-fitted LiDAR roof returns (0.2 m discs, closed 1.3 m, opened 0.6 m), + canopy over the interior, clipped to outline + 1.5 m, squared to the outline axis
source.imagery: USDA NAIP via USGS The National Map (public domain)

what_could_be_wrong: Roof modelled as simple hip massing blocks fitted to 2018 LiDAR (about 7.5 points per square metre): small dormers, bays and jogs under about 3 ft are not modelled.
Eaves: a 1 ft overhang past the wall line is assumed everywhere.
Stories from the LiDAR roof height.
check_against_ground_truth: Pitches: main 2-story roof 12/12, 1-story wing and upper side sections 7/12

mesh.frame: ft, x east, y north, z above ground

rules.eaves_on_walls: walls are extruded from geometry_ft.roof (the union of the facets), so every eave sits on a wall by construction; upper facets get wall blocks to their own eave (real-roof.js, g.clean)

blocks.note: pass 7: Nelder-Mead fit (5 restarts) of the pass-6 block list to the LiDAR DSM under the look rules (straight shared eave lines, level L ridge, coplanar NE slope, cuts); {"within_1ft": 75.1, "within_2ft": 86.3, "mae": 1.08, "bias": -0.26, "cover": 92.1, "p90": 2.77}
